# Isla

> Isla (islaclips.com) is an AI tool that finds the best moments in a podcast episode and turns them into vertical clips with captions for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels.

Isla was founded and is run by Abdullah Elewa. Contact: support@islaclips.com.

- It listens to the whole episode, picks the moments people are most likely to share, and explains why it picked each one.
- It frames them vertically (following the speaker, or a split screen for two people), adds captions, and cuts long pauses.
- On a computer, the video never leaves the user's device: clips are made in the browser.
- Works with episodes in any language. Free to start; paid plans (Pro, Studio) add more hours and no watermark.
